benzoic acid.loc:
Results and Discussion > Gram-Scale
Deconstruction of Pure PS and Real-World PS Foam ¶1

concerns: Irradiance not reported; only electrical LED power 14.4 W (two vials per LED roll), which is not an irradiance.
Wavelength: λmax ∼ 450 nm (¶1) but Mechanistic ¶1 says 'corresponding λmax = 466 nm, consistent with the LED emission spectrum'.
Gram scale: 10 mmol (1.04 g) PS in 20 mL EtOAc = 0.5 M repeat units (not 0.1 M); each tube individually in an LED roll (Photochemistry ¶2).
Figure 3 caption copies '~40% ... at 48 h are aromatic oligomers' from Figure 2 although gram-scale times are 64/72 h.
catalyst_loading as printed is 0.2 equiv (= 20 mol% vs styrene units).
Isolated benzoic acid yield 38% for PS foam (same ¶); total identified aromatics 60 ± 4%.
Mn ~59 000 from Materials ¶1.

paper_concerns: Other products with numbers not covered by any task: ethyl benzoate (~10%), acetophenone (~6%), benzaldehyde (~1%), total identified aromatics ~60% at 48 h (¶2); CO 21% and CO2 7.5% at 16 h (¶2); 34% benzoic acid with recycled catalyst after 24 h (¶2); 30 ± 2% at 16 h is also in ¶2.
Mw after 16 h given only as a range ('between 100 and 200') -> not recordable.

Table 1 entries 9-14 use catalysts B-G identified only by letter (structures presumably in a figure/SI) -> excluded; entry 15 is NHPI (H) + carbon nitride, 0 equiv H2SO4, 5.5% (text names NHPI) and could be a record; footnote d says 10 mg carbon nitride but Photochemistry ¶3 says 5.0 mg NCN-CNx.
Entry 4 (no PS) is a blank, not a polymer record.
Temperature 50 °C is LED heating, not controlled.
Catalyst loading stated two ways: 20 mol % (Table 1/¶3) and 0.2 equiv (Figure 2/3 captions).
